meta.question: on Waterbirds final K=29 runs (six token rules, seeds 1-3), does the masked teacher's fidelity to the full teacher under each run's own rule and own student rank the runs' val WGA and val accuracy?
meta.method: keep-only masked-teacher faithfulness (KL to the full teacher) per token rule, student/teacher attention rollout and last-block CLS attention; Spearman across runs with permutation test
meta.paper: Hooker et al. NeurIPS 2019 (keep-only evaluation); Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (attention rollout); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD); Hinton et al. 2015 (KD); Sagawa et al. ICLR 2020 (Waterbirds groups)
